description: Lunatyk, a sleepwalker, one bold shape filling the whole picture: a tall thin pale man walking in his sleep, eyes closed, a long blue and grey striped nightshirt, a long red nightcap, bare feet on tiptoe, both arms stretched straight forward, a faint silver moonlight glow on him, not a ghost, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, eerie and menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the figure alone, no branch, no ground, no background, the whole figure inside the picture
